Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
COTTON WEBBING FOR USE 
IN PACKING AERO-ENGINES 



(Reaffirmed 2002) 



1. Scope — Prescribes requirements of woven cotton webbing for use in the packing of aero-engines. 

2. tianufacture 

2.1 Shall be woven from cotton yarn of count: 

59 tex X 5 (or 10^5) in warp, and 
59tex X 3 (or 10V3) in weft. 

2.2 Shail have double plain weave. 

2.3 Should be free from all weaving defects. 

2.4 Shall be free from sizing, friling and dressing materials and from substances liable to cause subsequent 
tendering, 

3. Requirements — As given in Tables I and 2.

4. Make-Up and Packing— Webbings shall be made into tight rolls. The rolls shall be arranged in 
cylindrical bundles and shall be secured by jute twine x)f adequate strength. These bundles shall be wrapped 
in two layers of kraft paper [see IS : 1397-1967 Specification for kraft paper {first revision) ] followed by a 
third layer of waterproof packing paper [see IS: 1398-1967 Specification for packing paper, waterproof, 
bitumen laminated {first revision)] and finally with an outer layer of doth heavy cee (see IS : 3751-1966 
Specification for heavy cloth cee ) to form a bale.

IS: 6674 -1972 

5. Marking — Each roll shall be marked with the following: 

a) Name of the material; 

b) Name of the manufacturer, initials or trade-mark, if any; 

c) Length contained in the roll and width of the webbing; and 

d) Year of manufacture. 

5.1 ISI Certification Mark/ng — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi I. 
6i Sampling 

6.1 Lot — The quantity of webbing delivered to one buyer against one despatch note shall constitute a lot. 

6.2 The conformity of the lot to the requirements of this standard shall be determined on the basis of tests 
carried out on the samples selected from the lot. 

6.3 Unless otherwise agreed to between the buyer and the seller the number of rolls to be selected at 
random from a lot shall be in accordance with Table 3.
